title: Code Scout Nerium ( Discontinued )
features:
Code Scout Nerium
Released!

Tired of repeatedly checking a website for new codes? This script provides real time code updates. Just execute it and it will show the current active codes in-game. There are 665 supported games, view them at https://nerium.vercel.app/home

Main Tab
• Introduction
• Supported Check - input the game name and it will return if the game is supported

Code Active Tab
• Shows all active codes. Clicking a code gives two options:

° Copy 
° Remove

- Copy will add it to your clipboard. Remove will move the code to the Remove List, indicating you’ve already used it

•Refresh - reloads the script to update the list

Remove List Tab
• Displays all removed codes. You can return any code back to the active list

Expired List Tab
• Displays expired codes as history

API List Tab
• Shows all websites and APIs used

This script is safe. Avoid repeatedly executing it or you will be blocked for 10 minutes. All data is stored locally
